messages:
Janet (oncall): seeing repeated p95 spikes on the remote-write path to the proxy this morning. prometheus logs showing connection resets and a bunch of "dropped batch" lines. started ~08:42 UTC. anyone digging? :eyes:

Ashok: yeah noticed around the same time. node autoscale kicked and we saw a burst of exporter restarts. logs: 
```
> ts=2026-03-17T08:42:11Z caller=queue_manager.go:165 component=remote queue=0 msg="post failed" err="Post \"http://remote-write-proxy:9201/api/v1/write\": EOF"
> ts=2026-03-17T08:42:12Z caller=client.go:238 component=remote msg="dropped batch" dropped=482
```

Janet (oncall): ugh. that "dropped batch" number is the one that worries me. that explains the p95 jump. any idea why connections reset?

Maria: likely two things coupled: 1) the proxy is getting connection churn during autoscale (socket exhaustion / ephemeral port reuse), 2) some exporters were flipping `instance`/`pod` labels on restart so remote_write saw new series, increasing bandwidth and write pressure. combined -> queue overflow and dropped batches.

Ethan: can confirm the exporter label churn. grabbed a short metric dump and saw duplicate series with slightly different `kubernetes_pod_name` and appended `-0` suffix after rolling update. cardinality jumped ~1.4x for that job.

Ashok: quick mitigation options: increase `max_samples_per_send` / `queue_config.capacity` temporarily, tune `remote_timeout`, and add more backoff/splay on the proxy. but we should be careful — increasing capacity without addressing churn might just delay the failure. also we can add relabel rules to drop highly dynamic labels from the exporter metrics.

Janet (oncall): can you paste a suggested relabel snippet? I'd rather patch prometheus for a short window while we fix exporter.

Ethan: snippet that worked for us before: 
```
remote_write:
  - url: http://remote-write-proxy:9201/api/v1/write
    queue_config:
      capacity: 2500
      max_samples_per_send: 7000
      max_shards: 8
    retry_on_http_429: true
    remote_timeout: 30s
    write_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: ["kubernetes_pod_uid", "kubernetes_pod_name"]
        regex: ".+"
        action: labeldrop   # drop pod-unique labels from series to avoid explosion
      - source_labels: ["instance"]
        regex: "(.*):\d+"
        replacement: "$1"
        action: replace
```

Maria: also add a metric_relabel to drop obvious dup series (if same __name__ and same job but different instance) — not perfect but buys time. e.g.:
```
metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__name__", "job", "instance"]
    regex: "(.*);(.*);(.*)"
    action: keep
```
(we're using this to keep only necessary ones — adjust regex accordingly)

Ashok: on the proxy side, increase `tcp_keepalive_time` and bump the connection pool. our k8s NAT conntrack was also near limits; I scaled conntrack in the node pools and increased proxy replicas by +2. that stopped immediate EOFs.

Janet (oncall): did that reduce dropped batches?

Ashok: yes, after scaling conntrack and adding replicas the `dropped batch` rate fell from ~480/s to <10/s over 6 minutes. p95 followed down. still seeing some transient 500s from the proxy when a big pod rollout happens.

Maria: long-term fixes: 1) exporter's metric stability (stop including pod-unique ids in cardinality labels), 2) add relabeling rules in scraping job to normalize `instance` and drop high-card labels, 3) make remote_write autoscaling policy more conservative during infra churn, 4) add alert to SLO dashboard for sustained drop-rate > 1% over 5m.

Ethan: also proposal to add a small downstream dedupe consumer that coalesces identical series per batch — could cut bandwidth when autoscale churns replicas. maybe part of proxy improvements.

Janet (oncall): agreed on the short fixes. I'll: roll the relabel patch to staging now (write_relabel_configs), add an alert mute for the current incident window, and open a follow-up ticket for exporter changes. can someone PR the doc notes for runbook?

Maria: I'll PR the runbook: steps to add relabel, how to scale conntrack, proxy replicate commands, and what signals to watch (queue_drops, remote_write_errors, p95 ingestion). :thumbsup:

devops-bot: incident created: #INC-2026-1879 — 'remote_write batch drops during autoscale' assigned to eng-sre. timeline note added.

Janet (oncall): thanks all. follow-ups: Maria to PR runbook, Ashok to add proxy conntrack scaling playbook, Ethan to review exporter label hygiene. we'll revisit in next oncall handover. :white_check_mark:
